subject: EDUCATION
bill.title: Establishes timelines for review and approval by Commissioner of Education of annual certified audits submitted by approved private schools for students with disabilities.

action.description: Reported out of Assembly Committee with Amendments, 2nd Reading

posted_text:
🏫 NJ A1646 — NJ Schools Get Deadline for Audit Reviews

New Jersey private schools serving students with disabilities will now have a strict timeline for when the Commissioner of Education must review their annual audits.

The bill sets a seven-year limit for reviewing audits submitted after the law’s effective date, and a seven-year or two-year (whichever is later) limit for audits submitted before that date.

This change aims to prevent years-long delays that have unfairly impacted school budgets and accountability processes for approved private schools.

Sept. 17, 2026: Reported out of Assembly Committee with Amendments, 2nd Reading.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.njleg.state.nj.us/bill-search/2026/A1646
